user.title: Sunspots
user.description: Shared settings for all spots. Building data comes from Overture Maps (public tiles). Your location is never sent anywhere unless you allow Overpass.

data_description.data_source: Overture Maps is the default and only reveals map tile numbers. Overpass needs the option below.
data_description.allow_overpass: Overpass sends the spot's coordinates to a public OpenStreetMap server. Used only as the source or as a fallback if Overture tiles fail.
data_description.radius: How far buildings can shade a spot (100-500 m).
data_description.observer_height: Eye level above the ground at the spot.
data_description.floor_height: Used when only the number of floors is known.
data_description.default_building_height: Used when a building has no height, floors or type information.
data_description.cloud_threshold_sunny: Cloud cover up to this value still counts as sunny in the weather-aware sensor.
data_description.weather_entity: Optional default weather entity for cloud information.
data_description.cloud_threshold_partly: Cloud cover up to this value (and above the "sunny" limit) counts as partly sunny in the forecast.

user.title: New spot
user.description: Name the place and pick its exact location (for example the terrace table).

summary.title: Buildings loaded
summary.description: Found {buildings} buildings around the spot (source: {provider}). Share of the skyline with measured heights: {coverage}.

summary_low.title: Few measured building heights
summary_low.description: Found {buildings} buildings (source: {provider}), but only {coverage} of the skyline has measured heights (below {threshold}%). Shade results will be rough here. You can fix heights later under Reconfigure.

data_description.ground_offset: Height of the spot above (positive) or below the surrounding ground, for terraces and slopes.

add_height.title: Set a building height
add_height.description: Pick any point on the building and enter its real height.

add_obstacle.title: Add an obstacle
add_obstacle.description: Something that blocks the sun between two compass directions (0 = north, 90 = east).

progress.fetch_buildings: Loading building data. This can take a few seconds.

error.already_configured: A spot at this location already exists.
error.low_coverage_confirm: Tick the box to add the spot anyway.
error.no_building_at_location: No building found within 25 m of that point.

abort.spot_not_loaded: The spot's building data is not loaded yet. Use “Refresh building data” in the Reconfigure menu, or try again later.
abort.entry_not_loaded: Sunspots is not running. Check the integration page and try again.
abort.fetch_failed: Building data could not be loaded: {error}
abort.already_configured: A spot at this location already exists.
abort.correction_added: Correction saved. The sun times were recalculated.
abort.correction_deleted: Corrections deleted. The sun times were recalculated.
abort.no_corrections: There are no corrections to delete.

low_coverage.title: Some spots have mostly guessed building heights
low_coverage.description: For {spots}, less than {threshold}% of the skyline comes from measured building heights. Shade times may be off. Open the spot's Reconfigure menu, then Corrections, to set the heights of nearby buildings, or compare with what you see and use the calibrate action.

buildings_unavailable.title: Building data for {spot} could not be loaded
buildings_unavailable.description: Sunspots could not fetch building data for {spot}: {error}. If the spot already has building data it keeps using it; otherwise it stays unavailable and Sunspots tries again every 15 minutes. You can also use “Refresh building data” in the spot's Reconfigure menu, or allow Overpass in the Sunspots options as an alternative source (it sends spot coordinates to a public server).

no_building_at_location.message: No building found within 25 m of that point.

sun_below_horizon.message: The sun is below the horizon at that time, so there is nothing to calibrate.

refresh_failed.message: Building data could not be refreshed: {error}

map_too_large.message: The shadow map is too large to send, even zoomed in.

get_sun_forecast.name: Get sun forecast
get_sun_forecast.description: Returns the sunlit intervals for a day, plus class windows and hourly rows that take the weather forecast into account.

refresh_buildings.name: Refresh buildings
refresh_buildings.description: Downloads fresh building data for the spot.

set_building_height.name: Set building height
set_building_height.description: Overrides the height of the building at a point.

calibrate.name: Calibrate
calibrate.description: Tells Sunspots what you see right now, or saw at a given time, and adds a correction if the model disagrees.

observed.name: Observed
observed.description: Was the spot in the sun or in the shade?

at.name: Time
at.description: When you observed it; defaults to now.

render_shadow_map.name: Render shadow map
render_shadow_map.description: Returns a top-down SVG of the buildings and their shadows for a time (default now).

time.name: Time
time.description: Local time to draw; defaults to now.

theme.name: Theme
theme.description: Colours of the picture: light or dark.
